evidence: RPC/REST/ZMQ label; modifies httprpc.cpp, rpc/request.cpp, protocol.h, and bitcoin-cli.cpp to return JSON-RPC error objects on whitelist denials.
rationale: Alters RPC whitelist rejection handling to comply with JSON-RPC 2.0 specifications and fixes silent error ignoring in bitcoin-cli -generate. Returning structured error codes (-38 and -39) replaces empty HTTP 403 responses that violated doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md and broke clients expecting valid JSON bodies, requiring deliberate review of returned protocol behavior.
